svg.title: Cecil traces an imported election row to the goat recorded as a pupil.
svg.desc: A deterministic source-link shows an election-register row imported into attendance. Beneath the table, Roll Forty-Seven, a small black-and-brown goat with a white forehead mark, eats leaves while Cecil praises the record and Riju identifies the supposed pupil.
svg.text: Page 16, panel 3 · Low comic reveal beneath the register table

text.tspan: Cecil follows an imported election-register row into
attendance and identifies its most consistent pupil
as the goat standing beneath the records.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
